entities.summary: Pierre-Yves Dermagne is a Belgian politician who served as Minister of Economy and Employment in the De Croo Government led by Prime Minister Alexander De Croo between 2020 and 2025. He is affiliated with the Socialist Party. He was elected to the Belgian Federal Parliament in the 2024 Belgian federal election.
